d: The scene represents in the sides mountains of rocks on which 14 rivers lie, which bathe the kingdoms and provinces that are or were under the domination of the crown of France. In the perspective you can see the sea, and in the air Cinzia that descends in a great machine representing her sky.
The scene is changed in the wooded sides, and in the perspective in a large country adjacent to the city of Eocalia. Hercules.
Cala dal cielo Venus con le Grazie in a car. Venus, Hercules, choir of Thanks.
In the rest of the clouds of the said machine being ascended Juno, this one turns out to be sitting in a big peacock.
The scene turns into a great courtyard of the royal palace. Hyllo, and Iole.
Paggio, Iole, and Hyllo.
Paggio.
Deianira, Licco, Paggio.
Deianira, Licco.
The scene is changed in the cave of the Sleep. Pasithea, the Sleep, choir of Aure and Ruscelli.
Juno Cala from Heaven. Juno, Pasithea, the Sleep, choir of Aure and Ruscelli.
The scene is changed in a garden of Eocalia, and Venus falls from the sky to the ground, in a cloud, that disappears. Venus, Hercules.
Hercules, Paggio.
Hercules, Iole, Hyllo, choir of Damigelle, and Paggio.
Hercules, Iole, Paggio.
Come back to appear in the air Juno in his chariot with the Sleep. Juno with the Sleep, Hercules, Iole, Paggio.
Iole, Hyllo, Sleeping Hercules, Paggio.
Mercury of a flight awakens Hercules and parts. Mercury, Hyllo, Iole, Hercules, Paggio.
Deianira, Licco, Hercules, Iole, Hyllo, Paggio.
Deianira, Hyllo.
Licco, Paggio.
The scene turns into a sea on the quarrels of which are many towers, and in one of them Hyllo prisoner. Hyllo.
It appears in the said sea the Paggio in a boat. Paggio, Hyllo.
Hyllo.
It appears in the Juno air, in a great throne and falls to the rescue of Hyllo. Juno, Neptune, Hyllo.
Juno, Hyllo, choir of Zephyri, dancing, and playing.
The scene is spelled in a garden of cypresses full of royal tombs. Deianira, Licco.
Iole with the funeral pump, choir of Sacrificanti, shadow of Eutyro, Deianira, Licco, choir of Damigelle d'Iole.
The scene is changed to hell. Shadow of Eutyro, choir of Hell's Souls, Clerica, Laomedon, Bussiris.
The scene turns into a portico of the temple of Juno Pronuba. Hercules, Iole, Licco, Deianira, choir of Priests of Juno Pronuba.
Iole, Deianira, Licco, Hyllo.
Cala Junone in the last car courted by the harmony of heaven, and appears in the highest part of these Hercules married to Beauty. Junone, Deianira, Iole, Hyllo, Licco.
Hercules, Beauty, choir of Planets.
